articles.title: Peru’s penguins are in trouble. A super El Niño could worsen things
articles.snippet: Bird flu, overfishing and warming seas have crashed the world’s largest colony of Humboldt penguins. Scientists are working to help them bounce back.
articles.summary: Peru's largest colony of Humboldt penguins is struggling due to bird flu, overfishing, and warming seas, while scientists try to help them recover. A super El Nino weather event could make these problems even worse for the penguins.

articles.title: A new flying drone uses touch to perch like a bird
articles.snippet: The drone's human-inspired fingers use touch to get a grip. This avoids some obstacles that come with relying on vision to perch.
articles.summary: A new flying drone uses touch-based fingers to grip and perch like a bird. This method helps the drone avoid obstacles that usually happen when relying only on vision.

articles.title: Experiment: Construct and test paper rockets
articles.snippet: Ready for take-off? Build your own rockets with paper, tape and straws. Then, take a deep breath and launch them with your lungs!
